note: 官方 zh-CN 词条表里**那几族「数据面」词条**（键太多、不走手写的 `Core/Loc.cs` 表）。来源 = `数据/游戏数据/官方本地化_en+zh-CN.json`（原版 I2 `I2Languages` 远端包，2026-10-14 解开）。**键 = 原版词条键原样**（拼法见 `工具/_loc_official/gen_official_names.py` 文件头）。运行时取值口 = `Core/Loc.cs` 的 `Loc.BulkOr(键, 兜底)`（跟语档、缺键出声）；🔴 **手写表 `Loc.HasEntry` 排在它之前** ⇒ 两处同键时手写表赢（所以本产物只补手写表里没有的）。⚠️ 值里可能带 I2 记号（`[[..]]` / `((..))` / `<sprite name=..>`）—— 那是官方模板，印之前要过记号渲染层（`A1763`）。⚠️ 值带记号时 `Loc.BulkOr` 会先过 `CardIcons.RewriteMarks`；渲完仍留着记号才回兜底 + 出声（判据 → 资料/普查产出_第三十一会话/AC_Loc记号闸.md）。

entries.en:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in famous battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
The more victories you can achieve, the better the reward at the end!
entries.zh:
选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中的著名战役中面对其他玩家！
通过在提供的张牌群体中选择，以选秀的方式走向胜利，创建你的活动卡组。
你能取得的胜利越多，最后的奖励就越好！

entries.en: During the War of Beasts Marneus Calgar openly challenged the Warmaster. Urged to humiliate the Chapter Master, Abaddon and his elite teleported before Calgar and his retinue on Saint's Haven, where battle immediately broke.
entries.zh: 在兽之战期间，马涅乌思·卡尔加公开挑战了战帅。阿巴顿和他的精英应邀羞辱战团长，他们在圣港前方传送到卡尔加和他的随从面前，战斗立即爆发。

entries.en:
Choose a Warlord to lead your army and face other players in grand battles across the grim dark Galaxy!
Draft your way to victory by picking between the offered card packs to create your event deck.
Explore the drafting menu during the demo and see how many victories you can achieve!
entries.zh:
选择一位战将来领导你的军队，并在阴暗的银河系中与其他玩家进行宏大的战斗！
通过在提供的卡组群体中选择，制定你的赛事卡组，以此来赢得胜利。
在演示过程中探索选秀菜单，看看你能获得多少胜利！

entries.en: In a Galaxy ripe for conquest, the many warring factions fight to claim it for their own. There is no respite, there is no haven, there is only the law of blade and bullet. Will you be able to lead your faction towards the path of eternity?
entries.zh: 在一个熟透的征服星系中，许多交战的派系为了自己而争夺它。没有休息，没有避难所，只有刀剑和子弹的法则。你能否引导你的派系走向永恒之道？

entries.en:
Skirmish is a fast-paced game mode that packs all the intensity of a Classic match into fewer turns, making every battle exciting from the very start.
Key Features:
· 12-card decks
· Up to 4 Legendaries (Warlord not included)
· Warlords start with 10 less Health
· Player 1 starts at 3 Energy, Player 2 at 3+1 Energy
· Gain +2 Maximum Energy each turn and accumulate 1 unused point.
· Overtime begins earlier
· No Offence card. Random Defence card. No mulligan. Jump straight into action!
Note: Skirmish mode is still in testing. Rules may change as its development moves forward.
entries.zh:
散战是一个节奏快速的游戏模式，它将经典比赛的所有激烈程度压缩到更少的回合中，使每一场战斗从一开始就充满刺激。
主要特点：
· 12张卡组
· 最多4个传奇（不包括战将）
· 战将开始时健康值减少10点
· 玩家1开始时有3点能量，玩家2开始时有3+1点能量
· 每回合增加+2最大能量并累积1个未使用点。
· 加时开始的时间更早
· 没有进攻卡。随机防御卡。没有淘汰。直接跳入行动！
注意：散战模式仍在测试中。随着其开发的推进，规则可能会有所改变。

entries.en: <color=#E27E1B>Choose your side. Fight for glory!</color> Score points for your team and tip the balance of war. Only one shall triumph!
entries.zh: <color=#E27E1B>选择你的一方。为荣耀而战！</color> 为你的团队得分并改变战争的平衡。只有一个将胜利！

entries.en: Earn skulls in Skirmish, Classic or draft to boost your team’s score and your own. All players on the winning team will receive a special reward when the event ends.
entries.zh: 在小冲突、经典或选秀中赚取骷髅头，以提升你的团队得分和你自己的得分。所有在胜利团队的玩家在活动结束时都将收到特殊奖励。

entries.en:
Classic is a competitive and tactical game mode featuring longer matches in which to fully explore your strategic and deck-building prowess.
Key Features:
· 30-card decks
· No Legendary card limit
· Warlords start with 10 more Health
· Both players start at 2 energy
· Gain +1 Maximum Energy each turn
· Overtime begins later
· Second player gets their selected Defence card
· Both players get to mulligan their starting hand
entries.zh:
经典是一个竞争和战术游戏模式，特点是比赛时间更长，让你充分发挥你的战略和卡组建设才能。
主要特点：
· 30张卡组
· 无传奇张牌限制
· 战将开始时多10点生命
· 两位玩家开始时各有2点能量
· 每轮增加+1最大能量
· 加时开始时间更晚
· 第二位玩家得到他们选择的防御张牌
· 所有玩家都可以调整他们的起手牌
